title: Herbed Pilaf with Garlic Bread Crust
description: A delicious pilaf dish with a crunchy garlic bread crust. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cube the wholesome bread and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the rosemary sprigs to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a baking dish and top with the cubed bread.
Drizzle the bread with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, until the bread is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
